verses.text: I am tired of living. I will let my complaint pour out. I will speak out of the bitterness of my soul.
I will say to God, 'Do not just declare me guilty. Tell me what charges you have against me.
Does it please you to crush me, to reject me, the work of your own hands, while you smile on the plans of the wicked?
Do you have human eyes? Do you see things the way people do?
Is your life as short as a human life? Are your years like ours,
that you must search for my wrongs and hunt for my sins?
You know that I am not guilty, but no one can rescue me from your hand.
Your hands shaped me and made me. Will you now turn around and destroy me?
Please remember that you shaped me like clay. Will you now turn me back into dust?
You poured me out like milk and made me thick like cheese.
You dressed me with skin and flesh, and wove me together with bones and muscles.
You gave me life and showed me your faithful love. Your care has kept my spirit alive.
But you hid this plan in your heart. I know this was what you intended:
if I sinned, you would be watching me, and you would not let my sin go unpunished.
If I am guilty, how terrible for me! Even if I am innocent, I cannot lift my head, because I am full of shame and drowning in my suffering.
If I hold my head up, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show your amazing power against me.
You keep bringing new witnesses against me. Your anger against me grows. Your armies attack me wave after wave.
Why did you let me be born? I wish I had died before anyone saw me.
I wish I had never existed, but had been carried straight from the womb to the grave.
My life is almost over. So stop! Leave me alone, so I can have a little comfort
before I go to the place from which I will never come back, the land of darkness and deep shadow,
the land of deepest night, of deep shadow and confusion, where even the light is like darkness.'"
